en.summary: Character.AI has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy. Court documents show assets and liabilities between $50 million and $100 million, and the company has agreed to sell select assets and a non-exclusive perpetual technology license to Disney for $20 million. The sale process is expected to close in late November or early December, with the platform remaining operational in the meantime, but no competing bidders have emerged—if no buyer is found, the platform will shut down. The company had previously struggled with lawsuits over underage users and a Texas investigation, and its attempts to pivot to AI video generation, social feeds, and short dramas failed to gain traction.
en.reason: Character.AI, the interactive chatbot platform launched just five years ago, has filed for bankruptcy and will sell some of its assets to Disney for $20 million.

Court documents show assets and liabilities between $50 million and $100 million, and the company has agreed to sell select assets and a non-exclusive perpetual technology license to Disney for $20 million. The sale process is expected to close in late November or early December, with the platform remaining operational in the meantime, but no competing bidders have emerged—if no buyer is found, the platform will shut down. The company had previously struggled with lawsuits over underage users and a Texas investigation, and its attempts to pivot to AI video generation, social feeds, and short dramas failed to gain traction.
en.reason: Character.AI, the interactive chatbot platform launched just five years ago, has filed for bankruptcy and will sell some of its assets to Disney for $20 million.

en.summary: ElevenLabs announced that Baroness Campbell of Surbiton today delivered a speech in the UK House of Lords using an AI-reconstructed voice built by the company, a first for the UK Parliament. The Baroness has spinal muscular atrophy, which affects her speech, and the AI voice replicated the tone, rhythm and pitch of her original voice. ElevenLabs says its technology has helped more than 11,000 people who lost their voice to injury or illness restore it, and has pledged to help 1 million people worldwide who have lost their voices.

primary_item.summary: ElevenLabs 宣布，Baroness Campbell of Surbiton 今日在英国上议院使用由其构建的 AI 重建嗓音发表演讲，为英国议会首次。Baroness 患有脊髓性肌萎缩症影响说话，AI 嗓音复刻了她原声的音调、节奏和音高。ElevenLabs 称其技术已帮助超过 11,000 名因伤病失声者恢复嗓音，并承诺帮助全球 100 万失声人群。

en.summary: ElevenLabs announced that Baroness Campbell of Surbiton today delivered a speech in the UK House of Lords using an AI-reconstructed voice built by the company, a first for the UK Parliament. The Baroness has spinal muscular atrophy, which affects her speech, and the AI voice replicated the tone, rhythm and pitch of her original voice. ElevenLabs says its technology has helped more than 11,000 people who lost their voice to injury or illness restore it, and has pledged to help 1 million people worldwide who have lost their voices.
en.reason: Baroness Campbell of Surbiton spoke in the UK Parliament's House of Lords using an ElevenLabs AI recreation of her voice—a first—which replicated her tone, rhythm and pitch despite spinal muscular atrophy; ElevenLabs says it helped over 11,000.

sources.title_original: Building Long-Running Agents with ScaleDown and Deep Agents
sources.summary: LangChain 发布 langchain-scaledown 集成，并在 LangSmith LLM Gateway 中支持 ScaleDown 的约束解码模型（CDM），用于降低长时智能体上下文管理的成本和延迟。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇内容介绍 ScaleDown 的 CDMs 如何经 LangChain、Deep Agents 中间件总结旧历史、压缩工具结果并抽取数据；原文称窄任务上比前沿模型快 200 倍、便宜 467 倍，Summarize 比 GPT-5.5 等平均便宜 41 倍。

en.summary: LangChain releases the langchain-scaledown integration and adds support for ScaleDown's constrained decoding model (CDM) in LangSmith LLM Gateway, cutting the cost and latency of long-horizon agent context management.
en.reason: LangChain released langchain-scaledown, bringing ScaleDown's constrained decoding models to LangSmith LLM Gateway so Deep Agents middleware can summarize old history, compress tool results and extract data, claiming 200x faster and 467x cheaper on narrow tasks.
